question: A 45% profit is made when a discount of 45% is given on the marked price of an item. If the discount on the marked price of the same item is 50%, then the profit will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Profit = 45& , Discount = 45% , another discount = 50%

**Concept used:**

Discount is calculated on market price and profit is calculated on cost price.

**Calculation: **

Let the cost price is 100

Selling price is 145

The market price will be 145 × 100/55 = 263.63

Now the discount is 50%

New sp will be 263.63 × 1/2 = 131.81

The profit will be 131.81 - 100 = 31.81 %

⇒ 31 (9)/(11) \%

**∴ The correct option is 1**
